agent_summary: Customer reports UPI payment of Rs 2,499 debited 3 days ago with order failure and no refund received. Initiated reversal and compensation per RBI TAT rules.
customer_reply_draft: Sorry for the inconvenience. We have initiated a reversal of Rs 2,499 for your UPI transaction and will credit Rs 300 as compensation for the delay. The refund should reach your account within 1 working day, and you will receive a confirmation SMS shortly.

proposed_actions.name: initiate_reversal
proposed_actions.rationale: Customer reports UPI payment of Rs 2,499 debited 3 days ago with order failure and no refund yet. Amount is within auto-reversal limit of Rs 5,000.

proposed_actions.name: credit_compensation

params.reason: 3 days late beyond RBI T+1 TAT; Rs 100 per day late

proposed_actions.rationale: Regulatory clock: 3 days late on UPI, Rs 100/day compensation due. Total Rs 300, but auto-compensation limit is Rs 1,000 so full amount can be auto-credited.

proposed_actions.name: send_reply
proposed_actions.rationale: Customer requested callback but policy requires written confirmation of resolution actions taken.

reasoning: Facts: UPI payment of Rs 2,499 debited 3 days ago with order failure and no refund. Amount within auto-reversal limit. Regulatory clock: 3 days late on UPI, Rs 100/day late.
